description: This file defines React components wrapping Radix UI Tabs primitives with custom styling, including Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, and TabsContent components.

methods.name: Tabs
methods.description: Root component for the tabs, using Radix UI's TabsPrimitive.Root.

methods.name: TabsList
methods.description: A list container for tab triggers, forwarding refs and applying custom styles.

methods.name: TabsTrigger
methods.description: A button component for individual tab triggers, with custom styles and state handling.

methods.name: TabsContent
methods.description: Container for the content panels associated with tabs, with styling and ref forwarding.
